name: reference-mod-frontend
description: The reference mod's status view, compiled as a Svelte 5 custom element (<mod-reference>) for self.chat's runtime mod loader (cavekit-mods-frontend-client.md R7). Standalone, not part of self.chat's own app build. Compiled output lands at ../entry.<hash>.js.
//deps: Everything is a devDependency ON PURPOSE: Vite's lib mode externalizes `dependencies`/`peerDependencies` by default, which would emit bare `import ... from 'svelte'` / 'socket.io-client' the browser cannot resolve (import-map sharing is out of scope for this kit). devDependencies are bundled, yielding one self-contained entry.<hash>.js.
